final:
swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex swapped([]) == []
  ex swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex swapped([1, 2]) == [2, 1]
  let n = xs.len()
  var r: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    var j = i
    if n >= 2
      if i == 0
        j = n - 1
      if i == n - 1
        j = 0
    r.append(xs[j])
  r

swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  post xs.len() >= 0
  ex swap_ends([1, 2, 3])
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let first = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
    xs[n - 1] = first
